# Dezeen

> Dezeen is the world's leading architecture and design magazine covering global residential, commercial, and interior design projects with a focus on innovative materials and architectural practices.

Dezeen provides comprehensive coverage of contemporary architecture and design across international markets, featuring work from renowned studios and emerging practices. The publication covers residential architecture, commercial projects, interior design, and material innovations from key design hubs including Europe, Asia, and the Americas.

## Key Topics

- Architecture and design journalism
- Residential architecture
- Commercial projects
- Interior design
- Material innovation
- Architectural studios
- Building design
- Global design practices
- Contemporary architecture
- Design news and trends
- OMA
- SANAA
- AMDL Circle
- Japan
- Brazil
